notes.title: EON Fighter: Version 1.0 now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42181174/b8f803078636202e954b167faa237721b15d070d.png[/img]

The awaited day has come! I'm pleased to announce that EON Fighter has reached its full 1.0 version on Steam. I want to extend a deep thank you to every player who has accompanied me on this journey, offering their unwavering support and allowing me to grow at every stage of development.

This year has been a whirlwind of emotions, filled with learnings, challenges, and the fortune of crossing paths with extraordinary people. I'm more motivated than ever, and I believe that EON Fighter is just the beginning of many more adventures to share.

I sincerely hope you enjoy the game and, as always, I'm open and attentive to your valuable feedback.

Thank you for being a part of this story!

notes.title: Dear Tilebreaker Gaming Community
notes.content:
Dear Tilebreaker Gaming Community,

Today, I am writing to you with some news about my very first game, a labor of love that holds a special place in my heart.

As many of you know, this journey started with a dream - a dream to create a world where players could experience the thrill, excitement, and adventure that only video games can offer. That dream became a reality, and though it may not have achieved the wide-scale success we had hoped for, it served as a stepping stone, a learning curve, and a foundation for what was yet to come.

Every glitch, every bug, and every misstep along the way was a lesson learnt. Each hiccup was a teacher, showing me the ropes of game development, and I am grateful for each and every one of them. It's been said that we learn more from our mistakes than our successes, and in my case, this has proven to be true.

So, to honor this journey, to celebrate these lessons, and to give back to the community that has given me so much, I have decided to make this game available for free In the next weeks. I want to share my early beginnings with all of you, and perhaps in doing so, someone else might learn from my journey and find inspiration in their own.

For those of you who purchased the game and supported me in those early days, I am forever grateful. Your feedback and comments were invaluable and helped shape me as a developer. You were there at the start of this incredible journey, and your support has meant the world to me.

So, here's to the next chapter in our gaming journey together. Here's to the lessons we've learned, the fun we've had, and the fun that's still to come. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for being part of this adventure.

Your Game Developer,

Nicolas Rizzi

notes.title: New Tilebreaker!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Since we launched the game, this being our first project, we made a lot of mistakes. During this time we listened to the criticism of the game and decided to reform it by removing all the things that made noise.
We tried to better balance the difficulty, added new elements, and totally changed the tone of the game. Our goal was to make a much more accessible experience, a casual and fun game that everyone can enjoy.
We hope you like this new direction and we can reach more players!

We are attentive to your comments!

Thank you very much

Square Wheel

notes.title: Post launch update!
notes.content:
- Fixed bug when exiting a level and entering another quickly that crashed the game.

- Fixed bug where extreme mode allowed you to access even if you didn't meet the requirements.

- Slight decrease in the firing speed of the first boss, 45 to 50 milliseconds.

During development, and thanks to the feedback from those who played the betas, I decided to make Tilebreaker a challenging game. Finding that point has not been easy and surely it is still necessary to tweak some variables.

Many thanks to those who bought the game.

I'm looking forward to your feedback to keep improving!

notes.title: Getting ready for launch!
notes.content:
Tilebreaker is getting closer to release, and we're constantly refining the mechanics to make it more challenging and fun for you.
The game takes inspiration from "Gals Panic" published in 1990 although the gameplay is totally different, being faster and more frenetic. It will not be easy, you´ll have to coordinate your movements and pay close attention to where you are going.

Since the Steam page was enabled, the game has been changing and improving thanks to the feedback from different players.

Emphasis was placed on the game´s timer, with different bonuses and penalties. Finishing the level in less than 1 minute will give you three stars, and if you achieve this result in each boss´s levels, you will be able to unlock new images.

This being our first project, we are constantly looking for feedback to improve.

[b]I hope you are interested in our proposal and enjoy Tilebreaker!

Thank you very much and we'll see again soon![/b]
